title: Inspect an ELF executable
description: These commands inspect ELF bytes, header fields, sections, and disassembled instructions.

steps.description: xxd shows the four-byte ELF magic number at the start of the file.
readelf -h displays header fields, including file class, machine, entry address, and header-table offsets.
readelf -S lists sections such as code, read-only data, initialized data, and zero-filled data.
objdump disassembles the first forty lines of the executable.
